name: alluvo-operator
description: Guided workflows (English-first, German trigger terms) for alluvo staffing-agency operators (Disponenten, Recruiter, BDRs). Turns the raw alluvo MCP tools into day-to-day jobs-to-be-done: bench monitoring, matching, Personalbedarf intake, Profilvertrieb/outreach, Dienstplan, Verträge, and data-quality triage. Bundles the alluvo MCP server (OAuth) — connect on install with your alluvo account.
